body:
sixteen hours' notice. that's the whole marketing plan folklore got in July 2020.

no lead single. no scheduled rollout. just an Instagram post the night before.

and then: she became the first artist in history to debut at #1 on the Hot 100 (with "cardigan") AND the Billboard 200 in the same week — two charts that have been running since the 1950s, and nobody had ever opened at the top of both at once.

all 16 tracks charted on the Hot 100 that week. three landed in the top 10.

sometimes the biggest flex is doing it with zero warning.

longlivets.com
